data.one_liner: Merges multiple input files into a single output file during the build process.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a builder that reads several source files and writes a single merged file. It supports optional topological sorting of inputs and custom output paths.
use_when: You need to combine generated code from multiple files into one file
You want to control the order of merged assets
You are already using build_runner and source_gen for code generation
avoid_when: You only need to generate a single file
You prefer a simpler, non‑stream based approach
strengths: Supports topological sorting to avoid dependency cycles
No runtime overhead – all work happens at build time
weaknesses: Only works with Dart build system
Limited to merging – not suitable for other code generation patterns
data.setup_notes: Add merging_builder to dependencies, configure build.yaml with build_extensions and options, run `dart run build_runner build`
data.minimal_example:
```dart
// build.yaml
builders:
  merging_builder:
    import: "package:merging_builder/merging_builder.dart"
    builder_factories: ["mergingBuilder"]
    build_extensions: {"lib/$lib$": ["lib/merged.dart"]}
    auto_apply: root_package
    build_to: source
```
